components.description: Shared UI components and context providers for application-wide functionality

component.name: PanelContext
component.purpose: Global context-based system for managing modal panels and overlays. Provides state management and data passing for any number of panels/modals.

type.name: PanelState
type.description: Record mapping panel IDs to their open/closed status

type.name: PanelContextType
type.description: Context API type for panel state and methods

fields.field: Check if specific panel is open

function.name: PanelProvider
function.behavior: 1. Maintain panels state (Record of panel id → boolean) 2. Maintain panelData state (Record of panel id → any data) 3. Provide context with all panel operations 4. Allow opening/closing panels and passing data
function.state: - panels: Object tracking which panels are open - panelData: Object storing data for each panel

function.name: isPanelOpen
function.description: Check if a specific panel is currently open
function.returns: True if panel is open, false otherwise

function.name: openPanel
function.description: Open a panel and optionally pass data to it

parameters.param: Optional data to pass to panel (optional)

function.behavior: 1. Set panels[panelId] to true 2. If data provided, set panelData[panelId] to data 3. Component re-renders with updated state

function.name: closePanel
function.behavior: 1. Set panels[panelId] to false 2. Panel is hidden but data may remain in panelData

function.name: togglePanel
function.behavior: 1. Invert panels[panelId] boolean value 2. Opens if closed, closes if open

function.name: setPanelData
function.description: Store data for a panel (doesn't affect panel open/closed state)
function.behavior: 1. Set panelData[panelId] to provided data 2. Useful for updating panel data without opening/closing

function.name: getPanelData
function.returns: Data stored for the panel or undefined
function.example: const data = getPanelData('ingredientPicker') // Returns: { category: 'proteins', mealId: 'breakfast' }

function.name: usePanels
function.returns: Panel context value with all operations

usage.requirement: Wrap your app root with PanelProvider

notes.note: Panels can be opened with or without data
Multiple panels can be open simultaneously
Data persists even after panel is closed (until explicitly cleared)
No built-in animations; animations handled by modal/overlay component

component.name: ConfirmationModal
component.purpose: Reusable modal component for confirmation dialogs, deletions, and important user actions. Supports both standard and destructive (warning) modes with customizable button text.

props.prop: If true, show warning styling for confirm button

behavior.step: 1. Displays Modal with 50% black semi-transparent overlay
2. Centered white/dark card with padding and border-radius
3. Shows icon (help or warning based on destructive flag)
6. Calls appropriate callback when button pressed
7. Modal closes when onCancel is called (handled by parent)

styling.element: - Full screen, semi-transparent black (rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) - Centers content vertically and horizontally
- Max width 340px, 100% width on mobile - Dark theme: dark background card - Light theme: light background card - Border radius: 16px - Padding: 24px
- Size: 48x48 - Destructive: Red warning icon (#ef4444) - Standard: Primary blue icon (COLORS.primary) - Margin bottom: 16px
- Font size: 20px - Font weight: 700 - Text aligned center - Theme-aware text color - Margin bottom: 8px
- Font size: 16px - Line height: 22px - Text aligned center - Subtext color (lighter) - Margin bottom: 24px
- Flex row with 12px gap - Full width
- Height: 48px - Border radius: 12px - Font size: 16px, weight: 600 - Cancel: Outline style with border - Confirm: Filled with color

component.example:
<ConfirmationModal
                visible={showDelete}
                title="Delete Meal?"
                message="This action cannot be undone. All ingredients will be removed."
                confirmText="Delete"
                cancelText="Cancel"
                destructive={true}
                onConfirm={handleDelete}
                onCancel={() => setShowDelete(false)}
            />
component.dependencies: - @expo/vector-icons: MaterialIcons for help-outline and warning icons - react-native: Modal, Pressable, Text, View, StyleSheet - useTheme hook for theme colors - COLORS constant for primary color

notes.note: Modal is controlled component; parent must handle visible state
onRequestClose is called when device back button pressed (calls onCancel)
Supports both light and dark themes automatically
No animation provided; standard React Native Modal default fade

hooks.description: Custom React hooks for shared functionality across components

hook.name: useTheme
hook.purpose: Provides theme colors (light/dark) based on system preference or user override. Respects user's profile theme setting while supporting system color scheme detection.
hook.dependencies: - react-native: useColorScheme hook - useProfile: Access user's themeOverride setting - COLORS constant: Theme definitions

logic.step: 1. Get system color scheme (light/dark) from useColorScheme()
2. Get user's theme override from profile (system/dark/light)
3. If override is 'system', use system scheme; otherwise use override
4. Determine isDark based on effective scheme
6. Return isDark, theme object, and effective scheme

returns.field: True if current theme is dark
Color object with text, background, card, border, subtext colors

theme.name: COLORS.dark
theme.color: Dark card background (slightly lighter than background)

notes.note: Requires ProfileProvider to be mounted (uses useProfile)
Automatically updates when system theme changes (if override is 'system')
Automatically updates when user changes theme override in profile
Can be used to theme any component (text, backgrounds, borders, etc.)
